result.topic_en: An administrative German note, not mathematics, stating that everything concerning astronomy and related subjects is left to Prof. Gauss, while something else is to be handed over to Prof. Harding; it is dated 3 June and signed with an initial.
result.transcription:

kann[?] er an Hrn Prof. Harding überlassen u. abgeben
auch[?] die verabredeten oder zu stiftenden[?]
